description: Host request views with filtering and grouping - host can see all requests filtered/grouped by guest (deliveryValue when NAME), location, or item.
steps: Create a new host component at src/components/host/RequestViews.tsx that provides three views/groupings of requests: (1) By Guest - groups requests by deliveryValue (when deliveryType is NAME, the deliveryValue IS the guest name), (2) By Location - groups requests by location name (using the location relation), (3) By Item - groups requests by the item field. Each group shows a count and expandable list of requests with their status. Include filter controls for status (NEW/SEEN/DONE/ALL) and category (DRINK/SUPPLY/SONG/OTHER/ALL).

The component should fetch from the existing GET /api/parties/[hostCode]/requests endpoint (which already returns all requests with location relation) and perform client-side grouping/filtering for responsiveness.
Add accessible tabbed navigation within the component for switching between group-by modes (By Guest / By Location / By Item). Use proper ARIA tabpanel roles.
Add visual badges showing counts per group and per status within each group.
Add a 'Views' tab to the host dashboard in src/app/host/[hostCode]/page.tsx that renders the RequestViews component. It sits between the existing 'Requests' tab and 'Menu' tab.
Subscribe to SSE events ('new-request', 'request-update') so the views update in real-time as requests come in or change status.
acceptance_criteria: Host can switch between grouping requests by guest, location, and item
Each group shows a count badge and the individual requests within it
Filters for status and category narrow the displayed requests
Real-time updates via SSE reflect new and updated requests without page reload
All interactive elements are keyboard navigable with ARIA attributes
verification: Run npm run build and confirm it succeeds with no TypeScript errors
Run npm test and confirm all tests pass
findings: Build and tests pass. The Views tab was added between Requests and Menu in the host dashboard. The component uses client-side grouping/filtering for responsiveness, supports SSE real-time updates, and uses ARIA tabpanel roles with keyboard navigation (arrow keys) for the group-by tab switcher. Review fix: changed guest grouping label for LOCATION deliveries from 'Unknown Guest' to 'Location-based Deliveries' since these are legitimately not tied to a named guest.
